title: Wudu flow chart and weekly tick chart
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Written for islamic-studies/y3 lesson 15 (Pupil PDF worksheet: wudu flow chart and weekly tick chart)
intro: Lesson 15: The steps of wudu in order. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: Saving water
points: The Prophet ﷺ used very little water
Turn the tap off between steps
Wasting is not loved by Allah

keywords.def: a must: something we have to do
what the Prophet ﷺ did, which we love to copy
the middle joint of the arm
the joint where the foot meets the leg

questions.q: Put these in order: arms, face, feet, head.
We wash the arms up to the ...
Is washing three times fard or sunnah?
Practical: make wudu at home with a grown-up and show each step to the camera, or fill the wudu flow chart on the pupil PDF.
questions.a: All steps in order, right before left, little water

questions.q: Extend: why do we start with the right?
questions.a: The Prophet ﷺ liked to start with the right in good things.

questions.q: Stretch: how can you save water in wudu?
questions.a: Turn the tap off, use a jug, wash once if short of water

options: Washing the feet to the ankles
questions.a: A) Washing the feet to the ankles. The feet are named in 5:6, so fard. Three times and the nose are sunnah.

questions.q: Think again: why does order matter in wudu?
questions.a: We follow the order Allah gave (5:6) and the Prophet ﷺ showed.
